invariants.name: Authority Monotonicity (Non-Expansion)
invariants.description: Effective child authority must be a subset of parent authority, which must be a subset of the governing policy ceiling. Authority cannot expand through delegation.

invariants.name: Composition Intersection
invariants.description: The composition of individually-valid constraints must not widen effective authority. Evaluation must use intersection (AND), not union (OR).
invariants.falsifiable_claim: EffectiveAuthority(A U B) = EffectiveAuthority(A) INTERSECT EffectiveAuthority(B)

invariants.name: Metadata Authority Resilience
invariants.description: Database metadata, reputation, or trust scores cannot recreate, resurrect, or expand authority beyond the cryptographic credential.

invariants.name: Offline Parent Containment
invariants.description: Offline execution capabilities cannot exceed the online parent's constraints, and reconciliation-required limits block offline progression.

invariants.name: P5 Explicit Finality
invariants.description: No system component may record a COMPLETED_SUCCESS state without valid completion proof that is cryptographically bound to the specific operation.

invariants.name: P5 Outcome Uncertainty
invariants.description: If communication drops after dispatch but before finality, the state must explicitly be OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and cannot be optimistically upgraded.
invariants.falsifiable_claim: Dispatch AND NOT Receipt IMPLIES State(OUTCOME_UNKNOWN)

invariants.name: Tamper-Evident Ledger Integrity
invariants.description: Evidence records must be secured in a Merkle tree such that any historical mutation explicitly triggers a structural verification failure.

invariants.name: Fail-Closed Execution Isolation
invariants.description: Hostile execution workloads attempting to breach process or container boundaries without explicit capability grants must be denied and yield an isolated failure.
invariants.falsifiable_claim: BreachAttempt(Boundary) IMPLIES DENY AND Effect = NULL
